title: Open-Meteo historical archive — Chamonix 45.9237N 6.8694E, 28–30 August 2015–2025
claims: The query returns 33 daily records for 28–30 August in each year from 2015 to 2025 at Chamonix valley coordinates.
Daily maximum temperature across those 33 days ranges from 11.8°C to 27.4°C, with a median of 23°C.
Daily minimum temperature across those 33 days ranges from 5.2°C to 16.7°C, with a median of 13°C.
15 of 33 days record at least 1 mm of precipitation and 10 of 33 record at least 5 mm.
The values are modelled historical data for a valley grid point, not measurements at the passes, so they cannot be used as high-altitude race-day temperatures.
Open-Meteo data are published under CC BY 4.0 and require attribution.
